chapter_title_en: Tariel Hears Tidings of the Loss of Nestan-Darejan
chapter_expert_explanation_en: Furious, King Parsadan blames his sister Davar (a sorceress who raised Nestan-Darejan) and swears to kill her. Davar beats Nestan-Darejan for instigating the slaying, puts her in an ark carried by two black sorcerer slaves into the sea, and commits suicide. Learning this from the bleeding Asmat, Tariel sets out in desperate search of Nestan.

stanzas.english_translation: "I went in, I arrayed myself quickly, accoutred I mounted my horse. A hundred and sixty good knights of long service joined me, we passed forth from the gates in order of battle. I went to the seashore, I saw a ship, the skipper saw me apparelled.
